$comment: Airdrop registry for /airdrops. Solana entries first (chain priority). Each entry: id, name, chain, family (solana|evm), status (confirmed|speculation|upcoming), criteria (with `check` = scored against the wallet-activity scan via the DSL in api/_lib/airdrop-eligibility.js; without `check` = manual protocol step surfaced as a to-do, never scored), estimatedValue (free-text range, parsed for the hero sum), optional deadline (ISO date), source (external research link), optional note. Statuses reflect public reporting as of 2026-08-06; this file is expected to be edited as programs confirm or close. Nothing here is a promotion or an endorsement; entries exist so a user can check their own wallet against publicly discussed criteria.
